interval.description: Sampling interval in seconds. 0 means single snapshot (boot averages).

count.description: Number of samples to display. 0 means run indefinitely.

interfaces.description: List of interface names to monitor. Empty list monitors all.

extended.description: Enable extended output fields (average packet size, saturation).

separate_util.description: Separate read and write utilization percentages.

mbps.description: Report throughput in Mbps instead of KB/s.
